projects.title: The Falling Backrest
projects.summary: An experimental chair exploring displacement and instability through a shifted backrest.
projects.concept: The backrest is intentionally displaced from its conventional position, creating a visual condition that suggests instability.
projects.question: What happens when a familiar element is pushed away from its expected position?
projects.transformation: The original chair geometry is transformed through the controlled displacement of the backrest.
projects.construction: Layered plywood structure combined with a steel supporting frame.

sections.heading: Design Process
sections.text: The design began by testing several degrees of displacement before arriving at the final configuration.
